title: Numbers as Exterior Prime Identity Matrices and the 94.7\% Grade-2 Semiprime Drop
description:
We formulate the prime number counting problem as an exterior algebra wedge representation on Hilbert space. We formalize in Lean 4 the Kronecker trace identity, Cholesky whitening telescoping drop, and exterior filtration theorems with zero custom axioms.
